post.description:
Create the platform super-admin (one-time bootstrap).

The bootstrap wizard does **not** create a tenant (decision 11): tenants are
created later from the platform console. Returns 409 when a platform admin
already exists or when the bootstrap lock is held.

schema.title: Response Setup Platform Admin Api V1 Setup Platform Admin Post

get.description:
T027: list tenants (lifecycle fields only, no business metrics).

Purged tenants are excluded by default; pass ``status=purged`` explicitly
to include them (the 1-month tombstone window, decision 19).
T027: lifecycle detail for a single tenant.

patch.description:
T030: update name / status (active <-> disabled) / memberLimit.

Archived and purged tenants cannot be re-enabled here — use the dedicated
``/restore`` and ``/purge`` routes instead.

Each field is independent: a payload that omits ``memberLimit`` must leave
the existing limit alone. Do not default it to the ``"null"`` sentinel —
that clears the limit on every rename (see ``update_tenant``).

delete.description:
T039: soft-archive a tenant (data stays intact, login is blocked,
licensing count drops, decision 18).

post.description: T031: reset the tenant's own admin password (no forced change on next login).
T041: restore an archived tenant back to active (data intact).

T045–T050: irreversibly delete a tenant (archived only).

``confirmName`` must exactly match the tenant's current name, otherwise 400.
Returns immediately with a task id; poll ``GET /tenants/{tenant_id}/purge-status``
for progress (mongo / vectors / files phases).

get.description: T046–T047: poll purge progress (mongo / vectors / files phases).

post.description:
SSO 换票：用 chat-api 签发的一次性 SSO 票据换取管理端 access token。

022 FR-14（T030 / QF-634）：令牌不再走 URL 查询串。
1. **POST 请求体**承载令牌（不落地址栏 / 访问日志 / 书签 / 分享链接）；
2. **一次性幂等**：票据内嵌的 ``session_id`` 在同一时刻只能换票一次，
   重放直接 401；
3. **fail-closed**：签名、过期、格式任一不满足即拒绝。

post.description:
Generate a TOTP secret for MFA provisioning.

Returns the base32 secret and an ``otpauth://`` URI that the frontend
renders as a QR code.  The secret is NOT persisted until ``/mfa/enable``
succeeds.

schema.title: Response Mfa Setup Api V1 Auth Mfa Setup Post

post.description:
Verify a TOTP code and persist the encrypted secret to enable MFA.

Flow:
1. Verify the TOTP code against the raw secret (from /mfa/setup).
2. Encrypt the raw secret with AES-256-GCM using the JWT secret.
3. Store ``mfa_secret_encrypted`` (for future verification) and
   ``mfa_secret_hash`` (for integrity check).
4. Revoke the current session — user must re-login with MFA.

022 Phase 1（T012）：绑定成功后发送变更通知（OQ-1：通道未接入时降级为
审计事件）并落 FR-23 审计。

schema.title: Response Mfa Enable Api V1 Auth Mfa Enable Post

post.description:
Disable MFA after verifying the current password.

022 Phase 1（T012）：解绑需要校验当前口令（防止令牌被盗后静默降级），
成功后发送变更通知并落 FR-23 审计；通知通道未接入时按 OQ-1 降级为
审计事件，并在响应中回显 ``notification.degraded``。

schema.title: Response Mfa Disable Api V1 Auth Mfa Disable Post

post.description:
Two-step login: verify TOTP code after password succeeds.

The first step (``POST /login``) returns ``{"mfaRequired": true, "mfaToken": "..."}``.
The client calls this endpoint with the mfaToken + TOTP code.  On success
a real access token is issued.

022 Phase 1（T011）：本端点接入 FR-3 限流与 FR-4 used_step 防重放 ——
校验失败按 ``username + tenant_id + client_ip`` 维度计数，5 次/300s 后
锁定；已通过校验的 TOTP step 在 90s 内不可重复使用。判定全程落 FR-23
审计事件。

schema.title: Response Mfa Verify Api V1 Auth Mfa Verify Post

post.description:
QF-350: Rotate refresh token and detect replay.

Flow:
1. Decode the refresh token.
2. 凭证不存在 → 吊销 family 并返回 401（未知 token 与重放同处置）。
3. 凭证已被轮换消费（`is_current=False`）→ 重放攻击，吊销整个 family
   并清掉该用户在本租户下的所有会话，返回 401。
4. 校验会话超时：绝对 24h（QF-352）/ 空闲 30min（022 T017）。
5. 一次性轮换：旧凭证置为 `is_current=False`，签发新凭证与新 access token。

SSOExchangeRequest.title: SSOExchangeRequest
SSOExchangeRequest.description:
022 FR-14（T030）：SSO 令牌走 POST 换票，不出现在 URL 查询串。

令牌作为请求体（``Content-Type: text/plain``）提交，等价于
``{"sso_token": "..."}``，从而避免令牌进入浏览器地址栏、访问日志、
书签与分享链接。

ErrorResponse.description:
统一错误响应结构（FR-10）。

与 RFC 9457 的映射：`type` ← 固定 `about:blank`（或 docs_url），`title` ← `code`，
`status` ← `http_status`，`detail` ← `message`，`instance` ← `docs_url`。
兼容层：`detail` 同时以 FastAPI 既有形态存在（见 handler 的 payload 组装）。

message.description: 人类可读错误说明，不含内部组件名/版本/路径（FR-12）
